subject.title: fix(ai): provider-billed totals desync the cost breakdown and drop cache writes

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose and persist `Usage.cost.estimatedTotal` as the catalog estimate replaced by a provider-billed `total`?
rationale: The field is exported through the plugin SDK and admitted by a closed worker protocol schema, so choosing its long-term semantics is a compatibility and product-contract decision rather than a mechanical patch repair.

options.title: Approve the additive contract
options.body: Accept `estimatedTotal` as an optional durable companion to provider-billed `total`, with the stated provenance and replay semantics.

options.title: Narrow the bug fix
options.body: Repair cache-write accounting and overflow detection now, while deferring the new public cost field to a separately approved API design.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive contract
recommendation.body: Accept `estimatedTotal` as an optional durable companion to provider-billed `total`, with the stated provenance and replay semantics.
